item.title: Fiber Test Lab — local, reproducible failure scenarios for Fiber payments (1 posts)
item.description: Hi everyone, I built Fiber Test Lab while trying to learn Fiber, and I’d really value your feedback It started from a problem I kept hitting: I wanted to write tests for what happens when a payment fails — not enough outbound liquidity, no route, an expired invoice, or a peer that goes offline halfway — and I couldn’t. Those are exactly the states that you cannot easily force on a shared testnet when you want them. So I ended up building a tool that makes these scenarios reproducible locally. fiber-lab up two-hop-route starts real FNN nodes plus a CKB devnet in Docker, opens the channels, runs the payment, checks the outcome, and records every RPC call along the way. item.title: Zedify — Fiber Network-native commerce platform for emerging-market merchants (1 posts)
item.description: Zedify is a merchant commerce platform giving small businesses — starting with food, fashion, gadgets, and vehicle sellers — a ready-to-launch storefront with Fiber Network payments built in from checkout, alongside fiat rails. Rather than requiring every merchant to commission custom development, Zedify uses a template-based shop builder with owner-controlled theming and checkout settings (including whether to accept pay-on-delivery), keeping delivery costs low while still integrating a production Fiber Network Node for real, routed CKB/UDT settlement. The storefront and dashboard are live today at wt-payments-frontend.vercel.app, backed by our own production FNN node on CKB testnet....

item.title: Obscell Web Wallet —— CKB 隐私钱包的浏览器版（纯前端） (1 posts)
item.description: 之前见 @quake 发过 obscell-wallet—— 一个跑在终端里的 CKB 隐私钱包（隐身地址 + 机密交易）。那版要下载二进制、装 Rust 工具链，对只想 “点开看看” 的人来说门槛有点高。于是我把同一个协议重写成了浏览器版：Obscell Web Wallet。纯前端，打开网页就能用，链上数据和 TUI 版完全互通。 在线体验：https://obscell-web.pages.dev 背景与致谢 先感谢 @quake（TUI 版 obscell-wallet 的作者）和 @Rea-Don-Lycn（obscell 合约原作者）。web 版不发明新协议：stealth 地址的 ECDH、CT 的 Pedersen 承诺、Bulletproofs 范围证明，全部沿用原版设计，协议参数逐位对齐。所以两个钱包读的是同一份链上数据 ——TUI 版收到的钱，web 版能扫到；web 版发的 CT 交易，TUI 版也能解开。 它是什么 一个完全跑在浏览器里的 CKB 隐私钱包： 隐身地址：收款地址可以反复使用，但每次收款链上都会出现一个不同的一次性地址；付款方用你的 view_pub 做一次 ECDH 派生，链上观察者无法把这个地址和你的收款记录关联起来 机密代币（CT）：金额用 Pedersen 承诺隐藏，链上只看到 C = v·G + r·H，看不到数值 Bulletproofs 范围证明：保证金额非负且在有效范围内，同时不泄露数值 代币发行与铸造：支持创建带供应上限的隐私代币（创世 + 增发） HD 钱包：BIP39 / BIP32...

item.title: Nervape Email Wallet (1 posts)
item.description: Nervape Email Wallet 1. 项目名称 Nervape Email Wallet：面向普通用户的 CKB 邮箱托管钱包 Nervape Email Wallet 是 Nervape 产品中的一项内置钱包功能。用户无需安装浏览器扩展、创建助记词或理解 CKB 地址和 Cell 模型，只需使用邮箱完成注册和登录，即可获得一个可用于 CKB、Spore 与 Nervape 数字资产的托管钱包。 它不是一个独立于 Nervape 的通用登录系统，而是 Nervape 降低 Web2 用户进入 CKB 生态门槛的产品入口。 2. 项目摘要 CKB 拥有独特的 Cell 模型、可编程密码学能力和以 Spore 为代表的数字对象协议，但普通用户首次进入生态时，仍然需要面对钱包安装、助记词备份、网络配置、资产准备和交易签名等步骤。 Nervape Email Wallet 将这些复杂性收敛到 Nervape 产品内部： 输入邮箱 → 完成邮箱验证 → 自动创建 CKB 钱包 → 领取或购买 Nervape Artifact → 在 Nervape 内查看、使用和转移资产 用户感知到的是一个熟悉的互联网账户，底层实际拥有独立的 CKB 地址，并通过真实的 CKB 交易持有和操作链上资产。 3. 背景 3.1 CKB 用户进入门槛 已经熟悉加密钱包的用户可以使用 JoyID、UTXO Global、OKX、UniSat、REI 等钱包进入 CKB 应用，但大量潜在用户并不具备以下知识： 什么是助记词和私钥； 如何安装并连接钱包； 如何准备 CKB 作为网络容量和手续费；...

item.title: Twine: Buy and Sell CKB Without Depositing on an Exchange (Fiber P2P PoC) (1 posts)
item.description: I use Binance P2P a lot. I have also watched people get locked out of those accounts, with their coins sitting frozen until the exchange decides to give them back. That is a bad way to buy and sell CKB with local money. Right now, onboarding into CKB via fiat has four major problems: Custodial risk and account freezes. item.title: SHRINCS: 324-byte stateful post-quantum signatures (1 posts)
item.description: A previous quantum resistant lock script was implemented using SPHINCS+, but its signature is quite large (from 8K to 50K). On a blockchain, storage is precious, and large signatures also impact TPS. Here we use SHRINCS, developed by BlockStream, which can achieve a signature of only 324 bytes in the minimal scenario. There are two methods of verifying SHRINCS: stateful and stateless. With stateful verification, the signature can be as small as 324 bytes, but the state (a count) must be stored on the local device.The other method is stateless verification, which works like SPHINCS+ but with a much smaller signature size (2.5K bytes). For most scenarios, a stateful signature can be used to...

item.title: A Revenue Layer for CKB Nodes (1 posts)
item.description: You make a fair point about RPC—technically it could work. But I think the real insight is: CKB already has a network. Why Leverage the Existing CKB Node Network? Here’s the real advantage: CKB already has 582 independent node operators (ref https://nodes.ckb.dev/). Instead of building a separate operator network for CRT, event-watching, or any new service, developers just: Write service code (deploy as a cell) Nodes automatically discover and run it Operators earn fees You don’t need to find, recruit, or convince operators to run your infrastructure. You don’t need to build reputation systems or staking from scratch. The network already exists with built-in incentives for independence....
